seam.proposal: Inject a pre-resolved damage profile at exactly three existing, already-certified join points without editing math: (A) BASE DICE: resolveDamageComposition line 972 is the only place the base formula enters math: `base = bonus.flags?.stockDamageFormula ?? String(weapon.system.damage ?? damageFormula ?? '1d6')`. Add a new optional context input `context.resolvedDamageProfile` (or `context.baseDamageOverride`) consumed one line above: `const base = context?.resolvedDamageProfile?.baseFormula ?? bonus.flags?.stockDamageFormula ?? String(...)`. Everything downstream (stepDamageDieFormula, extra dice, flat bonus, talent dice, crit multiplier) stays untouched. A resolver for dice/fixed/double/modifier/ammunition-payload/alternate-profile/conditional modes emits a plain dice string; 'none' returns a sentinel `{noDamage:true}` that damage.js checks before rolling (today buildWeaponDamagePacket 'formulaLooksLikeDirectDamage' already treats '-', 'special', 'by weapon' as non-direct). damageMultiplier (e.g. vehicle xN or 'double') maps to a post-roll multiplier applied in damage.js after safeRoll or as outer `(formula) * N` in buildDamageFormula options (new `options.profileMultiplier`) — buildDamageFormula(composition, options) already takes {extraTerms,isAreaAttack}. (B) TYPES/COMPONENTS: the packet side already accepts an authoritative multi-type structure and it takes precedence over weapon fields: options.damageComponents (damage-component-rules.js:150, first in componentSources), options.damageTypes/options.damageType (damageTypesFromContext first entries; resolveDamagePacketType options.damageType), context.stun / context.ion / damageMode 'stun' (merged by mergeCombatWorkflowContextIntoRollOptions, combat-context-serializer.js:252-297). So the resolver should output {baseFormula, damageType, damageTypes[], combine:'and'|'or', components[], stun, ion, criticalMultiplier, riders[], conditional[]} and be merged into rollContext at damage.js:47 (the same hook that already merges workflow context) — AND-type multi-damage -> components with fraction/amount; OR-type -> a chosen single damageType (choice made upstream, before roll). (C) CRIT: resolveCriticalMultiplier(actor, weapon, context, ...) already takes context.critMultiplier as a floor and weapon multiplier via getCriticalMultiplier (combat-stat-rules.js:726); pass the resolved crit multiplier via context.critMultiplier (floor) or add context.resolvedDamageProfile.criticalMultiplier to the max() set. The only change needed to make the weapon-field reads disappear is a profile-aware read in 4 helper spots (see directLegacyReads). To prevent 'name text' leakage set options.damageTypes explicitly; damageTypesFromContext still appends weapon heuristics, so add an `options.damageTypesAuthoritative === true` short-circuit in damageTypesFromContext (damage-type-rules.js:~160) to skip weaponSystemDamageTypes().
